goal: Stop evicting transactions by age so valid mineable transactions are not dropped from the mempool
Reduce memory footprint and per-transaction insertion overhead by removing the entry time index
agreement: Unaddressed objection: wallet resend test no longer checks parent resubmission before child (fametrano)
Objection to full removal instead of letting node operators revert if the change is harmful (ajtowns)
Open question whether confirmation data isolates expiry effects from RBF or direct miner relay (ajtowns)
Concept approval citing outdated justifications for expiry and immediate cleanup gains (stickies-v, maflcko)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because time-based eviction drops mineable transactions such as low-feerate CPFP parents
Eliminates an entire mempool index to save node memory and reduce insertion and deletion overhead
